publications.access_scope: Selected full Methods, Results and original figure legends inspected. Primary human TM material supports reciprocal ANXA2 interaction; purified cochlin gradients and expression assays support the cell-shape response. Proposed mechanosensing is separated from the measured effects.
Selected full Methods/Results inspected: human tagged constructs and recombinant vWFA2 assays. F527C retains collagen binding; the WT affinity quoted here is attributed to the earlier original study.

Full database Methods and scope inspected. The exact COCH proteomic/compartment record was not accessible. The official human masterlist independently confirms ECM-glycoprotein classification, not the narrower interstitial localization.
Complete genuine abstract inspected; original full text unavailable. It explicitly reports human DFNA9 variants and family phenotypes. No direct collagen or immune assay is attributed to this paper.

Complete genuine abstract inspected, not full Methods. It explicitly describes full coding-region transfection, secretion, glycosylation and proteolytic processing. Processed molecular-weight forms are not equated with UniProt splice products.

Complete genuine abstract inspected; full article not recovered in this review. Reciprocal CTL2/cochlin co-immunoprecipitation and ribbon-like basilar localization are positive findings; the anatomical basilar membrane is not automatically the GO basement-membrane compartment.

Complete original abstract and literal MINT SPR records inspected; full text recovery failed. The abstract directly reports isolated vWFA2 binding to collagens I/II/IV and lack of LCCL affinity for those collagens. Later human experiments corroborate collagen binding.
Selected complete Methods/Results inspected. Coch-null and G88E knock-in mice show different age/frequency-dependent auditory outcomes; early normal hearing is preserved in the interpretation.

Selected original Methods and official human matrisome masterlist inspected. The masterlist exact COCH/HGNC2180/O43405 row is ECM Glycoproteins; this classification does not distinguish basement from interstitial compartments.

Selected original full study read in the bounded core consultation. Mouse inflammatory cleavage/necessity evidence is distinguished from direct activity; negative LPS/bactericidal/macrophage tests and absence of a detected conduit defect are retained. Figure 5F/G and the corresponding Results place impaired local MCP-1/KC secretion before reduced immune-cell recruitment. This paper supplies indirect immune context, not an isolated LCCL migration assay or proof that LCCL is the sole recruiting signal.

Selected complete human case, mutation and RNA-analysis results inspected. Biallelic truncation is associated with early hearing impairment and reduced mutant RNA; this is clinical/functional-genetic evidence, not a direct matrix assay.

The protected cache is abstract-only and a complete local article was not recovered, hence full_text_unavailable is true. Selected authentic original article-in-press sections were inspected through indexed PDF text: Figure 7E/Discussion, STAR Methods Transwell Assay and Key Resources. DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.chom.2019.02.001; the text-bearing mirror is https://www.bktimes.net/data/board_notice/1553221879-23.pdf. The new primary-excerpts file preserves short literal source anchors and exact retrieved-response hashes. Human LCCL reagent and mouse responders are distinguished; no successful PDF download, publisher-hosted mirror, whole-paper read or figure-pixel inspection is claimed.

Selected full human reporter Methods/Results and mouse binding/localization experiments inspected. The human clone variant and engineered receptor design are explicit. Negative collagen readout in this reporter geometry does not refute independent purified-domain SPR. Its proposed LCCL-only glycan attribution is limited by later mouse domain-deletion data.

Selected original full Methods/Results inspected. These are mouse cochlin Fc/Protein-A fusions and domain mutants, including purified binding measurements. vWA1 is required in the tested constructs; human tissue staining uses mouse-derived probes and is not a direct human cochlin activity assay.

Selected full mouse tendon study read in the bounded consultation. Fibril and stiffness/peak-load changes are measured; elastic modulus does not differ significantly in the reported comparisons. Whole-tendon proteomics does not by itself resolve matrix subcompartments or direct mechanical work.

Original publisher full text and supplement inspected in the bounded consultation. The printed peptide is 61 residues matching human positions 51–111 despite the title wording; RAW264.7 treatment supports immune context, without establishing its receptor or equal full-product function. The protected repository cache is abstract-only, but genuine publisher full text and supplement were recovered externally; full_text_unavailable is therefore false rather than equating cache format with global access.
